Recovers by itself if it ever closes unexpectedly
Focus mode: just type your PIN to unlock early

email.subject: Important AVARA update: please install 1.2.4
email.intro: AVARA 1.2.4 is out for Windows and Mac. We read every review and crash report you sent, fixed the problems you told us about, and added new security and stability protection.

sections.title: Fixed from your reviews
items: Long questions now get a full answer in seconds (no more messages about Groq, Ollama or a local model)
AVARA no longer mistakes questions for commands: "time complexity" isn't the clock, "write a poem about rain" isn't the weather, and "how do I mute someone on Instagram" won't mute your computer
Settings → Appearance: colours now apply in every interface style, and Light mode works
Focus mode: to end a locked session early, just type your PIN on the lock screen

sections.title: Security & stability
items: If AVARA ever closes unexpectedly, it now reopens by itself within a few seconds
AVARA only types into other apps when you clearly ask it to ("type …")
Crash reports are only sent with your OK, with keys and passwords removed, and now tell us exactly what went wrong so we can fix it faster

sections.title: New
items: Attach any file in chat, even videos: ask "what is this video about?"
AVARA remembers your name: ask "do you know me?"
Mac (Apple Silicon) gets the same update today
